label: Text 1
transcript: Lina has a pen-pal in Tokyo. Sam has a pen-pal in Cape Town. The three of them compare their school days by e-mail. Tokyo: 8:00 to 15:30, six lessons and a cleaning duty. Cape Town: 7:45 to 14:30, with a break that involves actual fruit. Stuttgart: 7:55 to 13:20, no fruit, no cleaning. "We are very specialised," Lina jokes.

label: Text 2
transcript: In Tokyo, students clean their classroom every day after lessons. In Cape Town, the school year starts in January. In Stuttgart, students have free periods if a teacher is absent. In Tokyo, lunch is served at school. In Cape Town, many students bring fruit. In Stuttgart, lunch is at home or in the canteen.
